restored = root.parents[1] / "tmp/orthohmm-study-2026.10.09-rc6-restored"

    if p.exists() or p.is_symlink():

    selection=chosen, build=built, archive=archived, restore=recovered,
    restored_directory=str(restored), outside_checkout=not restored.is_relative_to(root),
    copied_verifier_executed=False, publication_ready=False, native_inference_repeated=False,
    scientific_scores_recomputed=False, public_archive_uploaded=False)

copied_verification.command:
env -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONUSERBASE -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /mnt/ca1e2e99-718e-417c-9ba6-62421455971a/ORTHOHMM/orthohmm/benchmarks/work/native_factorial_review_py310_20261004/bin/python -I -S -B -c '
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
cwd = Path.cwd()
repo = Path("/mnt/ca1e2e99-718e-417c-9ba6-62421455971a/ORTHOHMM/orthohmm")
checks = [
    ("outer", Path("bundle_publication_package.py"), "948efb04abfa84aea1c6822d9145592a15d54416838245f0c1bf569f5d81bbab",
     ".", "c82edae203a0daceaafb731e90c7115856326aa19eadeffbc2f37727930f8773"),
    ("terminal_direct", Path("terminal-direct-review/benchmark_tools/bundle_publication_review.py"),
     "4b9646bf7fd88c750bf9df4e7fad22c4fac6d5f9810cf211a639c15009a07999",
     "terminal-direct-review", "506c2a0b64d95282debb4eeae5b111fcaae39dbf8f5ebeb5e96f0319a227e396"),
]
results = []
for name, reader, expected, directory, index_sha in checks:
    observed = hashlib.sha256(reader.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if observed != expected:
        raise ValueError("Copied reader checksum differs")
    command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-S", "-B", str(reader), "verify", directory,
               "--manifest-sha256", index_sha]
    start = time.monotonic()
    done = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    result = dict(name=name, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), reader_sha256=observed,
                  returncode=done.returncode, elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                  stdout=done.stdout, stderr=done.stderr)
    results.append(result)
    if done.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    result["verified"] = json.loads(done.stdout)
value = dict(schema="publication_package_copied_verification_rc6_v1",
    workflow_revision="1b06c4049e22e25bd16e0a13e4004c37dfbfaa49",
    copied_verifiers_executed=True, outside_checkout=not cwd.is_relative_to(repo),
    executions=results, publication_ready=False, native_inference_repeated=False,
    scientific_scores_recomputed=False, transitive_runtime_restoration_proved=False,
    public_archive_uploaded=False)
path = repo / "benchmark_tools/results/publication_package_copied_verify_20261009_rc6.json"
with path.open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(value, indent=2))
'
